name_input: R CHEMINE PRODUCTS PVT LTD; R CHEMINE PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page for R CHEMINE PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/r-chemine-products-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 84 Records detected' and 'Trading Partners 5', but every visible row is an INBOUND shipment into India, e.g. exact line: '2026-02-23 | SUQIAN UNITECOMMERCE CO.LTD | R CHEMINE PRODUCTS PRIVATE LIMITED | UV STABILIZER 944(USED IN MFG.MASTER BATCH) | Shanghai, CHINA -> NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | HS 38123990 | BOL 7704992'. Other rows: 2026-02-17 YIXING BAOLONG NEW MATERIAL -> India, HS 29182990, BOL 7588867; 2026-02-13 'TO THE ORDER OF SDNF ARAB COMPANY' -> India, HS 38249900, BOL 7509242; 2026-02-07 QINGDAO SINOPLAS -> India, HS 34049020, BOL 7372582; 2026-01-04 SUQIAN UNITECOMMERCE -> India, HS 38123990, BOL 6700942. Top ports listed are all import lanes (Shanghai 6, TUMB ICD 6, EGYPT 3, NHAVA SHEVA SEA 3). No outbound/export row with an Indian port of loading, foreign destination or export B/L was seen. Source counter: page claims 84 total shipments; only 5 rows were actually visible in the free view, and 0 of those 5 are exports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. Attempts blocked: thecompanycheck.com (HTTP 403), zaubacorp.com (HTTP 403), eximpedia.app (HTTP 403), trademo.com (HTTP 403), volza.com (HTTP 403); DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'Connection refused' so no search results were available. ImportKey shows only the registered address 'TOWER A TF-01, EARTH ARTICA, Opp. NILAMBER 1, VASNA BHAYALI ROAD' and contact 918141195145 — an address is not supply evidence.
note: Role: importer/trader of polymer additives and masterbatch raw materials (UV stabilizers, antioxidants, PE wax, coated calcium carbonate) sourced from China and Egypt; the declared HS codes 293339/381230 do not match the observed import codes (38123990, 29182990, 38249900, 34049020) — per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground, the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the factual one. Factuality per Rule 5: (a) real customs activity IS confirmed, but on the import side only — 5 dated inbound records with B/L numbers, latest 2026-02-23; (b) no export shipment found; (c) no domestic supply evidence found. No traces of outbound supply (export or domestic) were found — the company's verified footprint is purchasing, not supplying. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources, not invented). CIN/PAN: null — not verified, the CIN used in one attempted URL was not confirmed by any source and must not be treated as real.
